map.基于轴对称烟羽模型计算烟羽质量流量、机械排烟量与烟层控制高度: Compute the plume mass flow, mechanical exhaust volume and smoke-layer control height based on the axisymmetric plume model.
map.烟气生成量按理想气体状态方程换算：V = m × T ÷ (ρ₀ × T₀)，其: Smoke generation is converted using the ideal-gas equation of state: V = m × T ÷ (ρ₀ × T₀), where m is the smoke mass flow, T is the absolute smoke temperature (K), ρ₀ = 1.293 kg/m³ is the air density at standard conditions and T₀ = 273 K; volumetric exhaust = smoke generation × safety factor (usually 1.2 to 1.5); exhaust-opening area = exhaust volume ÷ allowable velocity (natural exhaust 1 to 2 m/s, mechanical exhaust 8 to 10 m/s); the smoke-layer interface must be kept above the minimum clear height.
map.燃料顶面到烟层底部高度 z（m）: Height from the fuel surface to the smoke-layer bottom z (m)
map.烟层设计清晰高度 Hc（m）: Design clear height of the smoke layer Hc (m)
map.当 z ≤ zl 时：m = 0.032 × Qc^(3/5) × z: When z ≤ zl: m = 0.032 × Qc^(3/5) × z
map.其中 Qc = 0.7 × Q（对流热释放速率，kW）: where Qc = 0.7 × Q (convective heat release rate, kW)
map.烟气体积流量 V = m × T / (ρ0 × T0): Smoke volume flow V = m × T / (ρ0 × T0)
map.ρ0 = 1.2 kg/m³（空气密度），T0 = 293 K，T = 烟气温度: ρ0 = 1.2 kg/m³ (air density), T0 = 293 K, T = smoke temperature (K)
map.烟气温度估算：Ts = T0 + Qc / (m × Cp)，Cp = 1.0: Smoke temperature estimate: Ts = T0 + Qc / (m × Cp), Cp = 1.0 kJ/(kg·K)
map.本计算基于 NFPA 92 轴对称烟羽模型，适用于大空间排烟设计估算。正式设计须: This calculation is based on the NFPA 92 axisymmetric plume model and is suitable for exhaust-design estimation in large spaces. Formal design must follow the relevant codes and account for building geometry.
map.📚 深度解析：烟气管理系统设计: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Smoke Management System Design
map.大空间、地下与中庭项目按火灾热释放速率核算排烟量与排烟口布置。: For large-space, underground and atrium projects, calculate the exhaust volume and exhaust-opening layout from the fire heat release rate.
map.性能化设计中校核清晰高度是否高于人员活动区，保障疏散可视性。: In performance-based design, verify that the clear height is above the occupant activity zone to ensure evacuation visibility.
map.改造项目复核现有排烟口数量/风量是否满足规范要求。: For renovation projects, re-check whether the existing number of exhaust openings/airflow meets the code requirements.
map.Qc=3500 kW、清晰高度 3 m 的排烟量: Exhaust volume for Qc=3500 kW and clear height 3 m
map.按默认参数（对流热释放速率 3500 kW、清晰高度 3 m、烟层底部 5.0: With the default parameters (convective heat release rate 3500 kW, clear height 3 m, smoke-layer bottom 5.0 m): plume mass flow 35.38 kg/s,
map.39.4 m³/s，排烟量 141972 m³/h；烟层底部 5.0 m ≥ 清: 39.4 m³/s, exhaust volume 141972 m³/h; the smoke-layer bottom 5.0 m ≥ clear height 3.0 m, so smoke-layer control meets the requirement. The design recommends 10 exhaust openings at 14197 m³/h each; if currently insufficient, increase to 10.
map.清晰高度是烟层底部到人员活动地面的最小净空，须保证疏散通道内烟气层下仍有可呼吸、: The clear height is the minimum clearance from the smoke-layer bottom to the occupant activity floor and must ensure a breathable, visible space below the smoke layer in the evacuation route; it is generally not less than 2.1 m (above the occupant activity zone), and this project takes 3.0 m as the design value.

map.ASET，须按计算补足排烟口数量与单口风量。: ASET, so the number of exhaust openings and the per-opening airflow must be increased as calculated.
